question: How does the speed or tempo of the music feel?
subtitle: Focus on the overall speed of the beat or pulse.
hint: Compare it to daily activities like walking, jogging, or driving.

options.label: Slow & Leisurely
options.description: Like meditative breathing, a slow dance, or a calm stroll

options.label: Moderate & Steady
options.description: Like an average radio pop song or casual walking pace

options.label: Fast, Energetic or Frantic
options.description: Brisk workout pace, club dance floor, or all-out sprint

options.label: Not Sure / Freeform
options.description: Floating without a clear pulse, or hard to tell

question: How is the drumbeat or rhythm structured?
subtitle: Listen to the kick drum and overall beat pattern.
hint: Notice whether the drum hits steadily on every beat, rolls freely, or has a dance bounce.

options.label: Steady Club Thump (1-2-3-4)
options.description: Hypnotic, steady bass drum thumping on every single beat (thump-thump-thump-thump)

options.label: Lively, Bouncing Drum Beats
options.description: Scattered, energetic drum rolls like a funk drummer or classic hip-hop groove

options.label: Slow Head-Nod Bounce
options.description: Sluggish half-speed bounce with heavy bass drops (Trap / Dubstep / slow Hip-Hop)

options.label: Other Rhythm / Floating
options.description: Caribbean dance bounce, country chug, or floating without drums

question: Does the rhythm have a distinct dance bounce or speeding chug?
subtitle: Notice if the beat matches a specific regional style.
hint: Think of Latin dance, island reggae, or country train beats.

options.label: Latin Dance Bounce
options.description: Bouncy Caribbean rhythm ('boom... cha-boom-cha' heard in Reggaeton)

options.label: Relaxed Island / Reggae Beat
options.description: Chords chopping sharply on the off-beats with a relaxed sunny pulse

options.label: Speeding Train Chug
options.description: Fast country chugging rhythm (chugga-chugga-chugga)

options.label: Ultra-Fast Sliced Drum Rolls
options.description: Frantic, stuttering drum rolls sliced up at high speed (Jungle / Drum & Bass)

question: What instruments mainly drive the sound?
subtitle: Listen to the dominant sound sources across the track.
hint: Look for synthesizers vs real amplified or wooden instruments.

options.label: Electronic Synths & Beats
options.description: Produced inside computers with synthesizers, digital pads, and samplers

options.label: Amplified Electric Guitars
options.description: Loud electric guitar riffs, chords, solos, or heavy distortion amps

options.label: Natural Acoustic Instruments
options.description: Grand piano, violins, cello, acoustic guitar, or upright bass

options.label: A Blend / Other Instruments
options.description: Horns, hand percussion, country twang, or hard to isolate

question: Do any of these acoustic instruments stand out?
subtitle: Listen for signature organic or traditional instruments.
hint: Notice if horns, hand drums, or country twang are prominent.

options.label: Horns & Brass Section
options.description: Trumpets, saxophones, or big band brass blasts

options.label: Acoustic Hand Drums
options.description: Congas, bongos, wooden log drums, or shakers (Afro / Latin percussion)

options.label: Southern Country Twang
options.description: Weeping pedal steel guitar, banjo, or country fiddle

options.label: None of These / Standard
options.description: Standard band, electronic sound, or not present

question: What do the vocals or voices sound like?
subtitle: Focus on how the human voice is delivered.
hint: Notice whether there is singing, rapping, or if it is completely instrumental.

options.label: Purely Instrumental
options.description: No human singing or vocal performances at all

options.label: Clear Melodic Singing
options.description: Tuneful vocal melodies, pop hooks, or soulful singing

options.label: Rhythmic Rhyming / Rapping
options.description: Fast-talking spoken verses or rhyming over the beat (Hip-Hop / Rap)

options.label: Stylized / Other Vocals
options.description: Harsh screaming, heavy Auto-Tune, whispers, choir, or vocal chops

question: How are the vocals processed or performed?
subtitle: Listen to the special character of the voices.
hint: Notice if the voice is screaming, robotic, or ethereal.

options.label: Aggressive Screams / Growls
options.description: Throat-shredding screams or deep guttural monster growls (Metal / Hardcore)

options.label: Robotic / Auto-Tuned
options.description: Noticeable metallic Auto-Tune snaps or vocoder robot voices

options.label: Dreamy Whispers or Choir
options.description: Soft airy whispers, ghostly vocals in echo, or big choir harmonies

options.label: Natural / None of These
options.description: Standard singing, no heavy vocal effects, or purely instrumental

question: What does the bass sound like?
subtitle: Listen closely to the lowest frequencies.
hint: Notice if the bass is deep, buzzing, sliding, or funky.

options.label: Deep Rumbly Sub-Bass
options.description: Ultra-low rumble that shakes your chest, car, or headphones

options.label: Sliding Low Bass Booms
options.description: Deep bass booms that swoop and slide smoothly up and down in pitch

options.label: Growling Chainsaw or Squelch
options.description: Aggressive metallic robot growl or rubbery twisting acid synth bass

options.label: Funky / Acoustic / Standard
options.description: Funky slapped electric bass, acoustic upright, or gentle low end

question: How clean, warm, or gritty does the sound feel?
subtitle: Listen to the overall studio finish and clarity.
hint: Notice if it feels sparkling and crisp, cozy like vinyl, or dirty and distorted.

options.label: Sparkling Clean & Modern
options.description: Super crisp, bright radio production with zero grit or dirt

options.label: Warm Vintage Tone
options.description: Soft and smooth like playing an old 1970s vinyl record on warm speakers

options.label: Dusty Lo-Fi Crackles
options.description: Noticeable needle crackles, tape cassette hiss, or muted cozy bedroom sound

options.label: Raw, Gritty & Distorted
options.description: Abrasive crunchy fuzz, roaring overdrive, or blown-out speakers

question: If synthesizers are playing, how do they stand out?
subtitle: Listen to the dominant electronic melodies, chords, or effects.
hint: Notice whether they soar like an anthem, squelch, or aren't present.

options.label: Massive Festival Anthem Chords
options.description: Huge, buzzing walls of synths swelling into an epic stadium drop (EDM / Trance)

options.label: Twisting, Rubbery Squelches
options.description: Bubbling, whistling electronic synth lines that warp and squeak (classic rave sound)

options.label: Cavernous Space Echoes
options.description: Synth stabs or chords echoing repeatedly into deep space like in a huge cave

options.label: Subtle Glow or No Synths
options.description: Soft background pads, real instruments, or no notable synthesizers

question: How does the main drum beat or bass kick hit?
subtitle: Listen to the heavy low thump that drives the beat.
hint: Is it a heavy distorted rave punch, a crisp club thump, or a real wooden drum set?

options.label: Pounding Distorted Rave Kick
options.description: Heavy screaming punch followed by an earth-shattering buzzing bass roar (Hardstyle / Gabber)

options.label: Crisp, Solid Club Thump
options.description: Clean, punchy low kick that keeps the dance floor moving without harsh distortion

options.label: Natural Wooden Drum Kit
options.description: An organic acoustic drum set played with drumsticks by a human drummer

options.label: Soft Beat / Not Sure
options.description: Gentle taps, finger snaps, minimal beats, or standard drums

question: If guitars are playing, what do they sound like?
subtitle: Focus on the sound and style of the guitars.
hint: Are they bright and ringing, loud and screaming, or gentle acoustic?

options.label: Bright, Chiming Indie Guitars
options.description: Clean or slightly gritty ringing guitars that sparkle (90s indie / alternative rock)

options.label: Roaring Distorted Rock Riffs
options.description: Loud, heavy electric guitar power chords or screaming solos through an overdriven amp

options.label: Gentle Acoustic or Spanish Nylon
options.description: Warm, intimate fingerpicking on a Spanish or classical acoustic nylon-string guitar

options.label: No Guitars in This Song
options.description: Purely electronic beats, synthesizers, piano, or vocal only

question: What emotional mood or atmosphere dominates the music?
subtitle: Focus on the overall feeling the music creates.
hint: Consider whether the vibe is feel-good, sinister, or nostalgic.

options.label: Sunny, Joyous & Feel-Good
options.description: Bright, celebratory, and optimistic party energy that makes you smile

options.label: Dark, Moody & Menacing
options.description: Sinister, creepy, or gloomy vibe like a thriller movie or dark warehouse

options.label: Aggressive, Furious & Chaotic
options.description: High-adrenaline rage that makes you want to smash things or mosh

options.label: Nostalgic, Dreamy or Intimate
options.description: Sentimental longing for the past, quiet bedroom vibe, or sunset memories

question: How does the groove or motion make your body move?
subtitle: Notice the physical sensation of the rhythm.
hint: Notice whether it has a playful bounce or a stiff march.

options.label: Bouncy Swing or Shuffle
options.description: Loose groove with a playful skip that makes you sway side-to-side

options.label: Straight Robotic March
options.description: Rigid, steady metronome pulse marching strictly on the grid

options.label: Sudden Crushing Breakdowns
options.description: Music abruptly slams to a halt into a slow, crushing head-banging stomp

options.label: Standard / Not Sure
options.description: Standard rhythmic flow
